Name: A house for Linus
Author: bluestarkiller
Description:
Have you ever felt sad about poor Linus living in a tent during winter and wished you could provide him with a real home?

This mod will give Linus a real home and a place to read and care for his plants.

As usual, just drag and drop to your contents folder. This will replace the Mountain.xnb and Tent.xnb maps
Always backup your original files!

Make sure to check my other Linus mod for a young shirtless Linus: http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1185/?

If you have any other map edit suggestions or any issues with this mod let me know.
